name: HTC AT-528 Beard Trimmer And Hair Clipper For Men - Blue
description:
HTC AT-528 Professional Hair Clipper ✂️

Rechargeable Cordless Trimmer for Men

Specifications

Brand / Model: HTC AT-528

Input: 220–240V, 50/60Hz, 3W

Blade Material: Stainless Steel

Trimming Range: 0.5 – 12 mm

Charging Time: 8 hours

Run Time: Up to 45 minutes (cordless use)

Length Adjustment: 4 stages

Comb Sizes: 1mm, 3mm, 5mm, 7mm

Size: 18 × 4 cm

Weight: 200 g

Power Consumption: 3W

Type: Cordless (wireless use)

Features

Sharp stainless-steel blade with long-lasting performance

Easy cordless operation for convenience

4-stage adjustable trimming lengths for precise styling

Telescopic comb attachments (1–7 mm)

Built-in rechargeable battery with charging indicator light

Complete set with charging cable, brush, oil bottle, and protecting cap
